issues: Pre-existing hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (also flagged in iter132/133). Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: campaign_agreement.accept_agreement uses idempotent version-check ((await get_acceptance()...).get('version') == ver) — correct; re-accept after material term change works.
agreement_version() hashes over name/start/end/pct/min_transaction → any change forces re-acceptance, good.
hq_agreements projection excludes user_agent (only ip retained) — good for the console list; the full audit trail (incl. UA) stays inside signed PDF's acceptance record page.
email_doc_pack catches all exceptions inside accept_agreement so acceptance is still recorded when email backend is dead. Good failure isolation.

docs/send/{tid} calls _real_to which raises 400 when no real email — send-all catches HTTPException and adds slug to skipped[]; consistent behaviour on preview where admin@miracurl.com is suppressed as 'not real'.
campaign_docs.agreement_doc: pct is printed twice in Clause 4.1 ('10% ... i.e. 10%') via `{pct:g}%` — cosmetic, LGTM.
get_acceptance sort=[('accepted_at',-1)] returns latest — safe if there are ever multiple rows for same (tenant,campaign).
hq_send_pack_all does not de-dup notifications sent within a short window; consider a docs_sent_at cooldown if bulk button is spammed.
